title: Blooming Brocade

outfit_card.silhouette: A layered Victorian-pastoral ensemble featuring a fitted white lace-trimmed bodice, voluminous puff sleeves, and a full-length tiered green jacquard skirt with white eyelet lace insets.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A wide-brimmed straw bonnet adorned with a cluster of pastel roses, green ribbon bows, and trailing white lace veils.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: An off-shoulder white cotton blouse with semi-sheer organza insets, a high ruffled collar, and voluminous bishop sleeves ending in flared lace cuffs, detailed with floral appliqués.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A floor-length green silk jacquard skirt with vertical pleats, a bustle back, and multiple tiers of white floral lace trimming, worn over a crisp white petticoat.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A woven brown wicker basket overflowing with pink roses, green foliage, and trailing ribbons.
